record.summary: Arterra, a residential building at 300 Berry St. OpenStreetMap tags it as an apartment building and the building permit lists apartments, but the Assessor's 2022 roll classes its unit parcels as condominiums.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8704008 (3,887 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 270 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8704008 and 269 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (OpenStreetMap (way 48569995, 300 Berry St)); 98% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 97% of the lot.
notes.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8704008 (mapped 2008-07-29; active); the earlier outline came from: OpenStreetMap (way 48569995, 300 Berry St)

milestones.text: Arterra (300 Berry St) reported topped off at 16 floors (SocketSite, July 30, 2007, citing Intracorp; a reader comment dates the topping-off party about a week earlier). Intracorp expected completion and closing of escrows in spring 2008
Arterra (300 Berry St) completed: the per-unit condominium lots carry year built 2009 in the DataSF Assessor roll

Construction permit completed: DBI recorded new-construction permit 200509273964 (16 stories, 268 dwelling units, 300 Berry St) as completed on this date. A permit's completion date is not an opening date.

changes.text: Arterra now uses its Assessor lot lines.

Arterra's topping-off is now dated July 2007: SocketSite reported it on July 30, 2007, and a reader comment puts the party about a week earlier. The notes also now say Avalon II's Assessor lot is shared by four lots, not many per-unit lots.
Arterra now shows its construction permit as completed on Apr 6, 2009.

The map notes said about 275 units; the cited SocketSite post says 268, so a dated note was added. The 2009 built year now cites the DataSF Assessor roll for the per-unit condominium lots at 300 Berry, the 2007 topping-out milestone cites its SocketSite post (16 floors, spring 2008 target), and the comparison with other condo-mapped towers no longer lists Avalon II and III.

open_questions: This record was created on 2026-09-27 to host Pier & Point's own field photos. Its summary is limited to what its cited source was re-read to confirm that day; fuller details already in Pier & Point's map notes for this building (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out where that source didn't state them. Not yet researched: no milestones, costs or facts.
DBI files the permit under block 8704, lot 001. This record is drawn from OpenStreetMap rather than an Assessor parcel, so the block and lot are not a join to the record.
